rationale: Use the second locally archived Titan23 serial baseline to expand the second architecture family without selecting on TilePlace outcome.
required_evidence: input hashes and official Titan 2.0.0 acquisition provenance
complete routed-connection and atom timing-pin mapping accounting
baseline and candidate native VPR route plus analysis with identical frozen parameters
aggregate matrix regenerated with the result retained
retention_rule: Retain the case whenever input capture, legality, determinism, and both native closures pass, regardless of wirelength or CPD direction.
failure_rule: Do not substitute a different benchmark revision, SDC, seed, channel width, router option, strategy parameter, or VPR binary after observing an outcome. Record infrastructure or mapping failure separately instead of reporting QoR.
